get.description:
Return a list of active Projects.

If the authenticated user has full company admin permissions the request will return all of the projects in the company. If the user does not have full company admin permissions, the request will only return the projects that the user has been added to.
The default pagination is 100 projects per page. The max page size is 300 projects due to the size of the data in the response.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[by_status]
parameters.description: Filters on project status. Must be one of Active, Inactive, or All.

parameters.description: Filters projects to those matching the given string.

parameters.name: filters[project_number]
parameters.description: Filters on project number.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.description: The view determines which fields are returned. 'ids' return only id as an Integer (it additionally influences 'per_page' value to be strictly 200000), 'compact' returns only id and name, 'normal' returns more fields, while 'extended' returns all the project information

x-changelog.summary: Add creation_source field to List Projects
x-changelog.description:
Adds a nullable `creation_source` field to the response.

Values: `mfe_single`, `mfe_bulk`, `api_single`, `api_bulk`, `erp_import`,
`api_sync`, `internal_other`. Older projects may return `null` because this
value was not tracked when those projects were created.

x-changelog.summary: Fix is_demo filter to include projects with null values
x-changelog.description:
Fixed an issue where the filters[is_demo]=false parameter on GET /projects endpoint 
returned incomplete results. The filter now correctly includes projects where is_demo 
is either false or null, ensuring consistency with the API response behavior.
